name: South Bay Mutual Aid
description: A coalition of neighbors in Santa Clara and San Mateo counties. Runs a monthly free store with clothing, groceries and cleaning supplies, and a community garden, at the San Jose Peace and Justice Center. Started during the March 2020 shelter-in-place.
notes: Also on Mastodon (@southbaymutualaid@mastodon.social), which the app has no platform for. Spanish inferred from the full Spanish version of the site. Grocery delivery and mask programs are sunsetted.
